description.value: Kook is an upscale Korean BBQ restaurant in East Vancouver where diners cook premium Canadian-certified beef, pork, chicken, and seafood at their own table on Shinpo Systems smokeless grills. The restaurant's interior is designed around the five ancient elements — gold, wood, water, fire, and earth — and its ventilation system is engineered to eliminate cooking odors. A touring cyclist looking for a substantial, interactive sit-down meal after a long ride will find an extensive menu of prime cuts and 15-item banchan spreads.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, operating Korean BBQ restaurant at 2800 E 1st Ave #211A, Vancouver, with phone 604.566.5665 matching OSM. The website provides no evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi — all cycle-relevant amenities are null. Three different postal codes appear across website subpages (V5M 4P3, V5M 4N9, V5M 4N8), which is flagged as a concern but does not affect the inclusion decision.
concerns: Inconsistent postal codes across website subpages: footer shows V5M 4P3, locations section shows V5M 4N9, contact page shows V5M 4N8 — authoritative postal code is unclear.
Website footer email 'info@koookbbq.ca' appears to have a typo (three o's); reservations page lists a different email 'kookbbq@gmail.com' for large parties.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Korean BBQ restaurant confirmed by an active website with menu, reservations, and contact details.
